notes.title: Ten Dates Steam Daily Deal [plus a new FMV]
notes.content:
Ten Dates is on a Weeklong Deal!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628831/70900e2ce66ad05aeb39d4dbe822868407f1d9ac.gif

Ten Dates is the sequel to the interactive rom-com, Five Dates.

Misha, a millennial from London in search of that elusive in-person connection, tricks her best friend Ryan into going to a speed dating event with her. Each with their own five potential matches, Misha and Ryan must pluck up the courage and turn on the charm to date wildly different personalities.

Throughout the game, your choices and interactions will either strengthen or weaken your relationship with your date. Amidst a branching, multi-directional chain of conversation topics and deep-dive questions, Misha and Ryan are faced with ice-breaker games, awkward scenarios and unexpected truths. Will either find love?

notes.title: Brand New Ten Dates Trailer - Find Your Perfect Match
notes.content:
With Valentine’s Day just around the corner, together with developers Good Gate Media we wanted to share a brand new launch trailer for our interactive romantic comedy Ten Dates, slated for launch on PC, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, Switch, iOS and Android devices on February 14. A free demo is now available for PC and Mac via Steam.

Meet your new crush in Ten Dates’ new launch trailer below:

[previewyoutube=b-po5EYQ7O4;full][/previewyoutube]

As the sequel to Five Dates, the live-action FMV game will star Misha and Ryan, two millennial Londoners in search of their special someone at a speed dating event. 

Speed daters can witness how their choices can strengthen or weaken relationships with potential love matches. As Misha and Ryan attempt to charm five distinct personalities each, they’ll face daunting ice-breaker challenges, shocking revelations, and plenty of awkward moments. Long conversations and deep questions lead to a variety of different outcomes. 

'Attraction, dating and love are universal experiences we can all identify with,’ says director and writer Paul Raschid, ‘Our ambition for ‘Ten Dates' was to expand the world of ‘Five Dates' into a richer and more authentic range of dating options. The writing team included LGBTQ+ consultants who we worked with closely across the interactive storylines. We hope the result is a more inclusive experience which encourages people to try a variety of suitors. I’m really proud of what we’ve achieved and hope the audience will feel the same way.’

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628831/24634a954843c723aa5f6c0daba285b70cedff19.png

Key Features:


 Play as a female (Misha) or male (Ryan) Londoner looking for love

 Talent includes Rosie Day (Outlander), Charlie Maher (Conversations with Friends), Meaghan Martin (Camp Rock), Sagar Radia (Industry), Sam Buchanan (The Power), Kaine Zajaz (The Witcher), Ellie James (I May Destroy You), and Rhiannon Clements (Death On The Nile)

 Features LGBTQ+ and disability representation

 Real-time relationship status tracking evolves based on choices and influences the story

 Branching narrative and multi-directional chain of conversation topics

 Streamer mode and full controller support

Ten Dates - on it's way for Valentine's Day!

Check out more information and follow us on socials for the latest news and updates!

notes.title: Ten Dates is on Steam Next Fest October 2022!
notes.content:
Ten Dates is on Steam's Next Fest October 2022 Edition! The demo will allow you to play as Misha or Ryan as they navigate their post-pandemic love lives in the unpredictable world of speed dating.

The demo has 2 very different dates available, each with their own multi-directional chain of conversation topics you can explore including: ice-breaker games, awkward scenarios and unexpected truths.

Ten Dates is the much-anticipated sequel to Five Dates with even more content coming on launch.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42628831/fc00e61e5a53e444e53992c774eb1f58ad3676b3.png

The Ten Dates demo will be available October 3rd - October 10th exclusively on Steam. The demo has full controller support, Streamer mode, a whole new cast and location plus different endings available.

Wishlist and Follow on Steam to see a broadcast of the demo too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1946070/Ten_Dates

Ten Dates will be available in Q1 2023 on PC, Consoles & Mobile. Wishlist and Follow on Steam now!
